title: Amount in controversy
summary: The amount in controversy is the value genuinely placed in dispute for a jurisdictional statute. It is assessed by the governing legal standard and the claim at issue, rather than simply the amount eventually awarded.
notes: A small eventual recovery does not itself show that jurisdiction was absent at filing. Aggregating several claims or class members requires separate authority.

sections.Meaning: The amount in controversy is the value genuinely placed in dispute for a jurisdictional statute. It is assessed by the governing legal standard and the claim at issue, rather than simply the amount eventually awarded.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the statutory threshold and excluded items, the relief sought, and whether the claim was made in good faith. Apply the legal-certainty inquiry described in A.F.A. Tours and the notes. For injunctions, specify what interest is valued and which viewpoint the relevant rule permits.
